facts.business: Ajanta Pharma Limited is a pharmaceutical company engaged in branded generics across India, Asia, Africa, and US generics with a diversified product portfolio.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on Note 55 regarding search operations by Income Tax Authorities in August 2025 and subsequent notice under Section 158BC of the Income-tax Act, 1961

key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to variable consideration adjustments (chargebacks, rebates, recalls, medicaid, allowances, supply penalties, right of return)
Pressure to meet revenue targets and performance incentive schemes
Risk of fraud related to revenue being overstated by recognition in wrong period or before control passes
Income Tax search operations and subsequent notice under Section 158BC
